question: Please help me identify the top 3 bowlers who, in the overs where the maximum runs were conceded in each match, gave up the highest number of runs in a single over across all matches. For each of these bowlers, provide the match in which they conceded these maximum runs. Only consider overs that had the most runs conceded within their respective matches, and among these, determine which bowlers conceded the most runs in a single over overall.
sql:
-- Final query: Top 3 bowlers who conceded the most runs in a single over among max-runs overs
WITH over_runs AS (
    SELECT 
        b.match_id, 
        b.over_id, 
        b.innings_no, 
        b.bowler,
        SUM(ba.runs_scored) + SUM(COALESCE(er.extra_runs, 0)) as total_runs
    FROM ball_by_ball b
    LEFT JOIN batsman_scored ba ON b.match_id = ba.match_id AND b.over_id = ba.over_id AND b.ball_id = ba.ball_id AND b.innings_no = ba.innings_no
    LEFT JOIN extra_runs er ON b.match_id = er.match_id AND b.over_id = er.over_id AND b.ball_id = er.ball_id AND b.innings_no = er.innings_no
    WHERE b.bowler IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY b.match_id, b.over_id, b.innings_no, b.bowler
),
max_runs_per_match AS (
    SELECT match_id, MAX(total_runs) as max_runs
    FROM over_runs
    GROUP BY match_id
),
max_overs AS (
    SELECT o.match_id, o.over_id, o.innings_no, o.bowler, o.total_runs
    FROM over_runs o
    JOIN max_runs_per_match m ON o.match_id = m.match_id AND o.total_runs = m.max_runs
),
bowler_best AS (
    SELECT bowler, match_id, total_runs,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY bowler ORDER BY total_runs DESC) as rn
    FROM max_overs
)
SELECT bb.bowler as player_id, p.player_name, bb.match_id, CAST(bb.total_runs AS INTEGER) as runs_conceded
FROM bowler_best bb
JOIN player p ON bb.bowler = p.player_id
WHERE bb.rn = 1
ORDER BY bb.total_runs DESC
LIMIT 3
